hero.tagline: "For over twenty years I kept this story in silence. Today I choose to tell it — not as a victim, but as someone who went through it and came back."

intro.title: A story of two decades of silence — and the decision to finally speak.
intro.p1: At 21, Nevena trusted the promise of a better future outside Serbia. What she found was captivity and exploitation — an experience it would take her more than twenty years to speak about out loud.
intro.p2: Today she brings her story to TV programs, stages, and conversations with other survivors, with one simple goal: to show that it is possible to rebuild an entire life after its worst chapter.

ch1.title: The offer
ch1.text: A promise of work and a better life abroad — and the decision to trust someone she knew.

ch2.title: Captivity
ch2.text: Two years without documents, without freedom, under absolute control — until the rescue.

ch3.title: The return
ch3.text: Coming back to Serbia and more than twenty years rebuilding a life in silence, far from the spotlight.

ch4.title: The voice
ch4.text: The decision to break the silence — interviews, talks, and the choice to see herself as a survivor, not a victim.

quote.text: It was an old dream I had been holding onto for a long time — and it was finally coming true.
